purpose: Determine whether the C1R base constitutive family can obtain reference-quality WET_DRY near-saturation face fluxes with a hard finite non-table cost bound and fail-closed behavior.

candidate.face_equation: solve integral_h_above^h_below K(h)/(K(h)-q) dh = L for q
candidate.quadrature: 128-point Gauss-Legendre on t in [0,1] after h=h_above+(h_below-h_above)*t^8
candidate.root_solver: 64 fixed safeguarded bisection iterations after analytic deterministic bracket construction

scope.constitutive_family: Staringreeks 2018 unimodal MvG using KSATFIT, H_ENPR=0, KSATEXM disabled

hard_nonclaims: PASS does not admit this 8448-evaluation route as the normal RossFast production path.
PASS does not qualify saturation-transition timesteps, columns, runtime or MultiSWAP.
PASS does not reopen or rehabilitate the rejected near-saturation table line.
The adaptive quadrature plus Brent reference remains qualification oracle only.
hard_guards: No node density, table interpolation or Phi tuning is allowed in E2C.
No quadrature order, bisection count, probes or thresholds may be retuned after execution within this gate.
Any bracket failure or nonfinite evaluation fails closed.
Mass is represented by one antisymmetric face flux; no state is mutated by the face solve.
A later cost-reduction gate must preserve this E2C reference-quality envelope.
